brand.name: Data and Assumptions
card.abc.implementation: Local scenarios for all ten parties are published, with separate changes to the distribution and the overall volume of counts.
card.abc.limitations: Original values are retained outside model support. This is the scenario's extension rule, not evidence of no effect.
card.abc.origin: This is a research-project scenario, not a reconstruction of an external method.
card.card_only.implementation: This approach is presented only as a reference card. There is no executable reconstruction.
card.card_only.notice: Published approach described. No project calculation was performed.
card.cedar.implementation: The project defines an explicit reference-selection specification and publishes the model residual.
card.cedar.limitations: The public description does not uniquely specify the reference. The algorithm for manual regional applicability and the original normalization are unavailable. This is an adaptation.
card.cedar.origin: The public approach relates observed votes to a proportional expectation based on a reference interval.
card.d.implementation: Five comparison variants for one focal party — United Russia — are published.
card.d.limitations: The result is conditional on the selected comparison. Some groups may have no defined result.
card.novaya_1d.implementation: A three-component model is fixed. The output is the center of the component with the lowest mean.
card.novaya_1d.limitations: The original Datawrapper table, the authors' objective function, bins and numerical domain are unknown. The original implementation is unavailable. Exact historical replication is not claimed.
card.novaya_1d.origin: The public approach examines the one-dimensional distribution of the focal-party share through model components.
card.novaya_2d.implementation: The selected component's center and aggregate precinct membership at fixed thresholds are published.
card.novaya_2d.limitations: Separate public code and data, original covariances, scaling, weights and initialization are unknown. Dataset composition and participation definitions differ. Exact historical replication is not claimed.
card.novaya_2d.origin: The public approach examines components in the two-dimensional space of participation and focal-party share.
card.novaya_conventional.limitations: The reference, scaling, dataset composition and core are insufficiently described for exact reproduction.
card.novaya_conventional.origin: A description of a conventional Shpilkin construction is published.
card.novaya_overlap_core.limitations: The exact overlap estimate, core mask and excluded-region mask are unknown.
card.novaya_overlap_core.origin: A description of distribution overlap and core selection is published.
card.vazhnye_istorii.implementation: Explicit reference-window variants and the scenario share of valid votes are published.
card.vazhnye_istorii.limitations: Public implementation code, the exact estimation procedure and the source participation-field mapping have not been published. Data snapshots and the treatment of Moscow differ.
card.vazhnye_istorii.origin: The public approach uses a participation reference window for a scenario comparison of votes for the focal party and the others.
